notes.title: The "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya" Collaboration Update!
notes.content:
Starting from the November 24th update, we will be collaborating with[b] "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya"[/b], a Touhou derivative game created by 
二色幽紫蝶 and Re零同人社, in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045010/b9f4f79341366d320c8660f5e70dd5437c5b4bb4.png[/img]

In the main game, stalls of "Mystia's Izakaya" will be set up in various locations!

Find the ingredients she is looking for, and exchange them for various items!

[u]The following are the locations where she will appear.[/u]
School
Snowfield
Desert
Mines
Grave

In addition, the dotted three fairies also appear in the game "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya"! Please try to take orders from these three fairies!
Click here to visit the "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya".
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584090/Touhou_Mystias_Izakaya/
